source: EntangledOracle Elder Futhark resource table v2

runes.name: Fehu
runes.essence: Raw potential as movable wealth.
runes.gloss: Fehu is the herd — wealth that must be kept moving to stay alive. Mobile energy and resources at their earliest, rawest stage: the seed before planting, potential that can be gathered, spent, or left to rot.
runes.upright: Material success, earned abundance, the mobilization of resources.
runes.reversed: Loss of resources, stagnation, squandered potential, greed.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.essence: Untamed formative strength.
runes.gloss: Uruz is the wild ox — raw, unbroken vitality and the force that shapes matter into form. Strength before it is disciplined; the will that endures and the power that can gore as easily as it can plow.
runes.upright: Physical health, courage, overcoming through resilience and will.
runes.reversed: Misdirected force, weakness, brute-forcing a delicate thing.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.essence: The thorn — sharp, defensive, catalytic.
runes.gloss: Thurisaz is the thorn and the giant's strength behind it — a sharp force that wounds whatever rests on it carelessly. Conflict as catalyst, a targeted strike, the destructive power that can defend or harm depending on where it is aimed.
runes.upright: Breaking barriers, protective force, necessary conflict, a clearing strike.
runes.reversed: Danger, defenselessness, compulsion, betrayal, malice, spite.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.essence: Breath becoming speech and signal.
runes.gloss: Ansuz is the mouth — the origin of speech, the breath that carries a message. Wisdom transmitted and received, the divine signal; also the god Odin, whose counsel is mighty and never disinterested.
runes.upright: True vision, wisdom acquired, sound advice, clear communication.
runes.reversed: Misunderstanding, delusion, bad advice, manipulation, vanity.

runes.name: Raidho
runes.essence: Right movement in proper rhythm.
runes.gloss: Raidho is the ride — motion taken with direction, the rhythm of a journey over long roads. Travel of body or spirit, alignment with the natural order, the difference between drifting and going somewhere on purpose.
runes.upright: Right action, logical progression, travel, finding rhythm.
runes.reversed: Delays, disruption of order, a blocked path, falling out of sync.

runes.name: Kenaz
runes.essence: The torch — knowledge made visible.
runes.gloss: Kenaz is the controlled flame — the torch in the hall, the heat of the forge. The point where a process reveals its purpose and craft can be applied; knowledge that illuminates, warms, and shapes, but only where it is tended.
runes.upright: Light on a problem, creative fire, sudden knowing, applied skill.
runes.reversed: Loss of vision, creative block, false hope, a vulnerability exposed.

runes.name: Gebo
runes.essence: The gift — exchange that binds.
runes.gloss: Gebo is the gift freely given and the obligation it creates — an honor, a bond, an exchange of equal energy. The equilibrium of giving and receiving; reciprocity as relationship rather than transaction.
runes.upright: A mutually beneficial connection, a gift, equal exchange, a true bond.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.essence: Joy of a cycle completed well.
runes.gloss: Wunjo is the wisdom of the harvest reinvested — joy that comes from a process brought to good completion and shared in fellowship. Belonging, deep satisfaction, the contentment of a thing done right and seed set aside for next season.
runes.upright: Deep satisfaction, wellbeing, successful integration, belonging.
runes.reversed: Sorrow, isolation, friction in the group, chasing a false ideal.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.essence: Hail — uncontrolled clearing force.
runes.gloss: Hagalaz is hail — the whitest of grains, falling from the sky, melting to water that feeds the ground it battered. An external force, neither earned nor chosen, neutral in intent, that breaks down what stood before.
runes.upright: Uncontrollable events, necessary breakdown, weathering a storm, a paradigm shift.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.essence: Need as the friction that forges.
runes.gloss: Nauthiz is need pressing on the chest — constraint, hardship, the resistance that strips wanting down to true need. The friction that forges or grinds; a help and a healing to those who heed what it teaches before it forces the lesson.
runes.upright: Overcoming hard limits, knowing true need from want, being forged under pressure.
runes.reversed: Unnecessary suffering, the victim's story, deprivation, an unwinnable fight.

runes.name: Isa
runes.essence: Ice — stillness that holds and reveals.
runes.gloss: Isa is ice — clear as glass, beautiful and treacherous, a floor laid by frost. Stasis that halts all motion; a pause that preserves and concentrates; the still, unchanging surface the world sees until something exerts force upon it.
runes.upright: A halt or rest, gathering strength in stillness, a psychological block, holding ground.

runes.name: Jera
runes.essence: The year's turn — effort returned in season.
runes.gloss: Jera is the good year — the full turn of the seasons, the harvest that arrives only in its own time. The cycle completing, sown effort returning as fruit; entropy and renewal as one motion, indifferent to impatience.
runes.upright: A cycle concluding well, reaping what was sown, right timing, patience rewarded.

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.essence: The yew — the unmoving axis between worlds.
runes.gloss: Eihwaz is the yew — hard, evergreen, rooted, long-lived past the span of those who plant it. The axis connecting the realms above and below; endurance as active work, the still spine that holds while change moves through everything around it.
runes.upright: Spiritual strength, facing deep fear, a rite of passage, joining the seen and unseen.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.essence: The dice cup — fate, chance, the hidden.
runes.gloss: Perthro is the lot-cup, rattling with what has not yet fallen — mystery, chance, the play of fate in the warriors' hall. The hidden thing about to be revealed; intuition, the occult, the gamble whose outcome is not yet cast.
runes.upright: A secret surfacing, a turn of luck, trusting intuition, entering the unknown.
runes.reversed: Unwelcome surprises, a bad wager, harmful secrets kept, intuition lost.

runes.name: Algiz
runes.essence: The ward — protection and warning both.
runes.gloss: Algiz is the elk-sedge that grows in the marsh and cuts the hand that grips it — protection that is also a warning. The raised shield, the sanctuary, the link to a higher guardian; a boundary that keeps safe by being sharp.
runes.upright: Protection, a safe haven, strong boundaries, connection to a higher purpose.
runes.reversed: Vulnerability, a breached boundary, over-defensiveness, a severed connection.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.essence: The sun — undimmed life-force and clarity.
runes.gloss: Sowilo is the sun — the seafarer's hope, the light that guides the brine-horse home to shore. Unbroken life-force, clarity that burns off fog, the wholeness and victory of a thing fully illuminated and alive.
runes.upright: Success, brilliant clarity, achieving the highest goal, radiant health.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.essence: The fixed star — honor, justice, sacrifice.
runes.gloss: Tiwaz is the god Tyr and the star that never wanders — order held by self-sacrifice, the hand placed in the wolf's mouth to keep a binding oath. Justice, honor, the rational courage to do right at cost to oneself.
runes.upright: Fair dealing, honor, rational judgment, fighting for the right, a moral victory.
runes.reversed: Injustice, imbalance, over-analysis, blocked passion, sacrifice without end.

runes.name: Berkano
runes.essence: The birch — quiet, generative growth.
runes.gloss: Berkano is the birch — the first tree to green after winter, lovely in its branches, bearing shoots without seed. Gestation and gentle growth, the nurturing enclosure where new things are tended into being, rebirth that cannot be rushed.
runes.upright: A new beginning, healing, nurturing a project or bond, domestic peace.
runes.reversed: Stunted growth, domestic trouble, anxiety, clinging to what must be reborn.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.essence: Horse and rider — trust in motion.
runes.gloss: Ehwaz is the horse and the one who rides it — two beings moving as one, the joy of nobles on the road. Trust, partnership, the steady forward progress that comes only from harmony between the parts; movement that depends on a bond.
runes.upright: A strong partnership, advancing together, mutual trust, sure progress.
runes.reversed: Broken trust, disharmony, feeling stuck, motion forced without alignment.

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.essence: Humanity — the self seen through others.
runes.gloss: Mannaz is humankind — each person dear to their kin, each mortal bound to the same earth and end. The self understood through community, intelligence and memory and shared tradition; the mirror other people hold up to who one is.
runes.upright: Knowing oneself through others, collaboration, a place in community.
runes.reversed: Isolation, alienation from peers, self-delusion, refusing offered help.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.essence: Water — the deep, flowing, unconscious.
runes.gloss: Laguz is water — broad and unstable to those who fear it, the sea that no bridle can hold. Intuition and the unconscious deep; emotion, dream, the current that carries what reason cannot steer, and everything that moves beneath the surface.
runes.upright: Deep intuition, emotional cleansing, psychic sensitivity, being carried by life.
runes.reversed: Emotional overwhelm, ignored instinct, fighting the current, cold over-reason.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.essence: The sealed seed — potential gathering inwardly.
runes.gloss: Ingwaz is the seed enclosed and the god Ing who departs over the ways — internal growth in a sealed space, potential gathering in stillness before it is released. The necessary retreat; energy stored, a cycle quietly completed before the next begins.
runes.upright: Productive retreat, internal transformation, a conclusion before a new start.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.essence: Dawn — the breakthrough where opposites meet.
runes.gloss: Dagaz is daybreak — the Measurer's light, dear to all, the threshold where night becomes day. Breakthrough and awakening; the paradox-point where opposites balance and a whole new frame of seeing arrives at once.
runes.upright: A paradigm shift, light at the tunnel's end, radical awakening, sudden clarity.

runes.name: Othala
runes.essence: The homeland — inherited, rooted value.
runes.gloss: Othala is the ancestral estate — the homeland dear to every person, enjoyed rightly only with what it yields. Inheritance of blood, place, and spirit; the deep-rooted foundation, what is passed down and what one is bound to.
runes.upright: Inherited wealth of spirit or matter, a permanent home, honoring one's roots.
runes.reversed: Bondage to toxic tradition, a lost foundation, family dispute, uprootedness.

runes.name: Wyrd
runes.essence: The blank — fate withheld from knowing.
runes.gloss: Wyrd is the unmarked stone — silence given a face, the absence that the other runes are read against. The web the Norns weave beyond mortal sight; what is not yet meant to be known, the point where free will meets what has already been ordained.
runes.upright: The unknowable at work; a question asked too early; fate moving past comprehension; a clean slate on which anything is still possible.
